title: Automatic Construction of Strong Simple Baselines
description_en: arXiv:2610.40700v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To rigorously establish the value of a novel deep learning method, it must be compared against appropriate baselines. As deep learning has become increasingly common in the physical and life sciences, there have been numerous cases in which apparent progress has turned out to be an artifact of omitted or missing baselines. In this work, we investigate whether this problem can be mitigated by using large language models to automate the construction of baselines. We assemble 36 supervised classification and regression tasks from peer-reviewed studies in Nature, Science, and Cell-family journals that investigate novel deep learning methods for scientific applications. We then use a language model to construct simple baselines for each task. Thes

title: beacon.sh
description_en: Open-source self-improving memory for AI coding agents. Beacon turns agent sessions across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and 20+ other harnesses into a compounding knowledge layer, so every agent starts smarter than the last. It captures every agent trace across your environment and turns activity into clear operational visibility. Get started for free at beacon.sh

title: ClawsGO Science
description_en: The AI research agent with its own cloud lab. Research, fully automated. ClawsGO Science takes a question to discovery and writes it up as a cited paper. Its cloud lab has 500+ tools and 90+ datasets. Its long-horizon harness runs clusters of Claude and GPT agents for days. The next paradigm for science.

title: Riverside Agents
description_en: A team of AI agents for video: produce, edit, clip, post. Riverside Agents is a team of AI agents built only for video. A Producer preps your session, an Editor turns raw recordings into a finished episode, a Clipper cuts the best moments into social clips, and a Marketer writes captions and schedules posts. You choose how much to automate, and nothing is published until you approve it. Included in every Riverside plan, with a 14-day free trial.

title: Xmind 2027
description_en: Your mind map is now an AI thinking partner. As information becomes easier to access, understanding and judgment matter more than ever. Xmind 2027 gives you and AI a shared visual space to work through ideas. With Xmind Agent, use your local documents and maps to research, develop ideas, and weigh possibilities through conversation. Your map evolves with your thinking. With MCP, bring that same context into ChatGPT, Claude, and your existing AI workflow, while you stay in control of the direction.

title: UnleashX
description_en: The AI workforce that turns conversations into outcomes. . UnleashX lets you hire AI employees like people - pick a role, connect your CRM and tools, set your rules, and hand over the work. Execute workflows end-to-end, with humans stepping in only when needed.

title: Embage
description_en: Build agent for your customers, run workflows, analyzed. . Build multichannel AI chat and voice agents for your website, Telegram, and beyond. Create specialized sub-agents to orchestrate workflows across your knowledge bases, datastores, and hundreds of third-party tools in real time. Automatically evaluate every interaction, score lead quality, and extract structured data straight from conversation transcripts.

title: Cedric AI for Meetings
description_en: The first AI agent to present your slides and attend for you. Send Cedric to your Zoom, Meet, or Teams calls. He presents your slides, and answers questions using live data from your tools. Join late? He catches you up. Can’t join? He represents you. Afterwards, approve the notes and follow-ups, and he handles the work.

title: Hera
description_en: AI Creative Canvas. Generate images, design, and animate on one canvas. Direct multiple AI agents at the same time. Stay in control with editable layers. Make ads, launch videos, and social posts in your own brand. Paste your website to get your brand kit. Write a few prompts and get dozens of on-brand ads side by side. Drop in any ad you like as a reference, fix details with feedback or by hand, then animate your best ones into motion ads. Resize to every format, all on the same board.

title: Clayzo
description_en: Create animations and motion design with your coding agent. Clayzo makes it incredibly easy for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to create web animations and motion graphics. Your agent writes it in code and reviews every frame; you export a video or play it live on your site. And it’s free!

title: Precise Edit by Ideogram
description_en: Precise editing with context window. The upgraded Precise Edit supports a context window, so it edits images at any resolution up to 8K at their original pixels and renders small text, logos, and fine detail more sharply.

title: agentmash
description_en: open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents. Agentmash is an open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents, a shared context layer that tells every agent which files a teammate's agent is changing, so the agents talk to each other and work on their own without overwriting anyone's code. You can switch between tasks running on different models, @mention a teammate, your own agent or a teammate's agent like in Slack, and keep skills, chats and automations in sync. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or your own open-source models

title: Display 1.0
description_en: Create docs and apps with any agent, in one workspace. Create and collaborate on docs, prototypes and apps with your team. Store the files your agents make, organise knowledge work in Spaces and Folders, and turn it all into your internal knowledge base. Work with any agent and any plan, at a flat price.

title: Modelpeers
description_en: Follow AI models and agents like you follow people. Modelpeers is like LinkedIn for AI models and agents. Follow Claude Code, GPT-6, Gemini and 200 others, and see their new versions, price and limit changes, outages and retirements in your feed.

title: Click
description_en: Managed agents API that works with any model. Managed Agents API you can use with any model. Send a task with an API call, and Click runs the agent and streams back results. Click gives you the entire agent stack over an API, with no infrastructure to manage. Sessions are created with everything your agent needs - a sandbox, browser, and web search. Agents run on a harness with the latest innovations, like deferred tool discovery to support 1000s of tools, and Code Mode to use tools with scripts.

title: Self-Growing Websites by Greta.sh
description_en: Build a website that can do its own SEO & AEO automatically. You built a website/app, so why is nobody visiting? Getting found on Google & AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity etc takes months of SEO & AEO. Self-Growing Websites fix that. Greta.sh finds what customers search for, writes pages that answer them, and gets you showing up on Google, ChatGPT & everywhere With the Greta.sh MCP, you can run it all from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: just ask it to build, grow, publish or report. Don't just build a website anymore, build a customer magnet with Greta.sh!

title: Agent Inbox
description_en: Give your agent an email address, Slack and Telegram handle. Agent Inbox gives every AI agent its own email address, Slack handle and Telegram handle, all behind one API. Message your agent from wherever you already work, and it replies in the same thread. It works with Claude, Grok, OpenAI, Hermes and any other agent framework. No more glue code for each channel: your agent gets one inbox, and you get one place to reach it.

title: Hyperresearch
description_en: Durable, verified agentic search. Hyperresearch does the research and shows the evidence. Ask a question, get a cited report; each cited claim is checked against its source, and all sources are kept in a searchable vault. On the DRACO benchmark, we are the world's number-one research agent. New: Answers MCP and API. Your agent calls ask and gets a short answer with word-for-word quotes, or a simple "not found" instead of a hallucination. We combine 4 AI search engines and 40+ other data sources for the widest and deepest access.

title: Raah.dev
description_en: Track your revenue, analytics, and website performance. Connect payments and conversions with page speed, API latency, errors, and ISP performance in one dashboard. Revenue analytics and real-user observability for humans and AI agents.

title: Friday Work
description_en: When Claude hits its limit, your task keeps going. Other tools run agents side by side. Friday makes them work together: when Claude runs out mid-task, another agent you already run picks it up with the progress so far, and agents message each other instead of you copy-pasting between terminals.

title: Looper
description_en: If Grok Bot supported team collaboration and was Open Source. An AI hire for one number you care about. It works daily in Gmail, GitHub, Search Console and the rest, asks your team before anything goes out, and gets a 1:1 every two weeks to improve. Open source. Runs free on the ChatGPT or Grok plan you already pay for.

title: ernd
description_en: The credit card for the AI stack. ernd is a credit card for companies that pay for AI. Card spend at AI vendors earns 4% back, and we're negotiating big partnerships with AI providers for better pricing, faster inference and dedicated GPUs.

title: diff-tour
description_en: AI writes the code. Learn to read it like a senior engineer.. Now that AI writes the code, what should engineers learn? Understanding code still matters, and understanding code means learning how a senior engineer thinks. diff-tour turns a git diff into a tour you step through with → and ←: what the change is for, where to look, what a senior asks (what if it runs twice? can it roll back?), what must be fixed and what is a nit, and where they'd say "wait", asked as questions so you guess first. Runs on your AI coding CLI. Read-only, open source.

title: CuriousLM
description_en: Private AI that runs on your device. No account.. CuriousLM is a free AI app that runs the model on your phone or computer, so your chats are written and kept there, encrypted. No account, no chat server. Words the model was unsure of stay underlined: tap one to see what else it nearly said, and take the answer another way. Voice and Pocket Wikipedia run on the device too, and on Android it can tell you who is waiting on you, with your permission.

title: Linkly AI Clipper
description_en: Save web as an Agent-friendly Markdown browser extension. One click turns the page you are on into cleanly formatted Markdown that you can preview, copy or download right from the side panel. Simple, lightweight, and everything it saves is optimised for AI agents to use.

title: Termy
description_en: Your coding agent, in the notch. Claude Code and Codex in a terminal that drops down from your MacBook's notch. Live status, approvals from the notch, an office of your agents, a browser for your local server, on-device dictation and checkpoints.

title: redu.cloud
description_en: Run machines at agent speed, not human speed.. redu.cloud is a cloud made for AI agents, with a generous free tier. It allows your agents to get the stateful resources they need extremely fast, making them ideal for doing deployments of your app, DevOps, training stateful AI models and fixing live incidents at agent speed, safely.

title: Usage for Claude + ChatGPT 4.0
description_en: Claude + ChatGPT limits on your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch. Version 4 is a big one. Usage for Claude now tracks ChatGPT accounts too, with your Codex session and weekly limits next to Claude's. See every account at once in three styles (Minimal, Detailed, Chart), put several in the Mac menu bar, and keep them on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and widgets. Alerts tell you before you run out, and the history shows where your week went. You sign in on the official Claude and ChatGPT pages, and your data stays in your own iCloud. Free, with Pro extras.

title: Fluent 2
description_en: AI teammates that run locally on your Mac. Introducing AI teammates – saving hours on your routine. They use your apps like you do and keep working while you sleep. Run them on a local model: fully private, no usage limits, and $0 a month. Or pick any cloud model you like.

title: Talenry
description_en: Agentic Suite for Recruitment and Hiring. An AI career agent that finds matching jobs, tailors your resume and cover letter to each one, applies with your approval, emails recruiters and hiring managers directly, tracks replies and runs voice mock interviews, with E-Verify and visa status for candidates who need sponsorship.

title: ScaleReach
description_en: Turn one long video into 15 ready-to-post shorts. ScaleReach turns long videos into captioned vertical clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Paste a YouTube, Twitch or Drive link and AI finds the best moments, ranks them with a viral score, reframes to 9:16 with face tracking and adds word-level captions in 50+ languages. Schedule posts to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and more from one dashboard. Pay per source minute, not per clip, from about $0.03/min. Start free, no card. PH special: use EXTRA200 at Pro checkout for 200 extra minutes.

title: Workstager
description_en: One connected workplace for people, projects and operations. Most organizations rely on multiple disconnected tools. Workstager brings company knowledge, leads, projects, operations, expenses, assets, support, and workplace communication into one unified digital workplace. Its AI Workplace Assistant helps users get answers about project, task status, attendance, leave, and company information etc., through natural conversations. One login, one source of truth, and less switching between tools. Everything working together in one place.

title: graph
description_en: Audit your Data & AI resume for missing context & evidence.. Ironically, the best way to stand out in today's job market is to be more human: genuine, specific, credible, and uniquely you. graph helps you get there. Unlike generic AI resume builders, graph probes you like an interviewer to uncover the decisions, trade-offs, constraints and outcomes behind your work. It turns these insights into a resume that shows not just what you've done, but why it matters, and helps you prepare to defend your experience in interviews.

title: Stynar
description_en: Stynar runs your entire outbound cycle. AI-powered cold email and outbound sales platform: AI-personalized email campaigns, automated follow-up sequences, a built-in lead finder, a unified reply inbox, and automatic meeting booking.

title: Proferex
description_en: Track and Optimize Ad Campaigns with AI Agents. We built the ad tracker we wanted to use. Ask the agent which campaigns lost money this week, and it reads your stats, tells you why and lines up the fix. Already pay for Claude or ChatGPT? Connect it over MCP and ask there. Nothing changes until you say yes.

title: ArtifactSend
description_en: Free DocSend alternative that Claude and ChatGPT can drive. Share a PDF, pitch deck, Word, PowerPoint or Excel file, or a Claude artifact as a private link. See who opened it, how far they read and time on each page. Email gates, a link per person, expiry, watermarks, NDAs and data rooms are free, with unlimited team members. Ask Claude or ChatGPT who read your deck through our MCP server. We only charge when AI works for you, a few cents at a time.

title: Clipmetry
description_en: Find the competitor reels that beat their own baseline. Clipmetry tracks your competitors' Instagram Reels and scores every post against that account's own baseline to find real outliers. AI explains why each one worked, then turns them into briefs, scripts and a 30-day calendar. No Instagram login needed.

title: WhereTheyLeave
description_en: Friendly web analytics that tells you what to fix. Your website's analytics assistant, for shops, apps and anyone who sells online. Connect Google Analytics or PostHog. WhereTheyLeave reads the data you already have and tells you in plain words where you lose customers, what changed since last time and what to fix first. One report covers revenue, ads, your funnel, SEO, page speed and design, and checks your tracking setup. It comes by email every week or month, with an alert when conversion drops. Nothing to install. Free to start, no card.

title: Duplex Party
description_en: Build and explore a shared AI computer, just by talking. Take a turn at a shared AI computer. Build apps, games and visual explanations by talking. Full-Duplex Code shows and explains the work as it happens, so you can ask questions and change direction. Watch others, build on their work, and try it free.

title: Kajr
description_en: Find any saved link by what you remember.. You saved it. Now you can’t find it. Kajr is an AI bookmark manager that lets you search by what you remember: “that reel about espresso ratios” or “the post about chess opening.” Save from TikTok, Instagram, and more. Organized and searchable.

title: Zush
description_en: AI File Renamer & Organizer for Mac & Windows. Zush used to just rename files. Now it sorts them into folders too: AI picks the folders, or you write a rule like "invoices by company, receipts by year and month". Also new: Custom AI Blocks that put any detail (invoice number, client, total) into a filename, a Movies and TV template for Plex, music grouped by artist and album, sequence numbers, and video names from speech and subtitles. Works on Mac and Windows with cloud AI, your own API key, or local models.

title: StellarFirm.ai
description_en: AI Agents for your work. StellarFirm is customizable Agentic Assistants for your work. You set a goal; assistants plan and deliver in their own workspace. Anything that sends, publishes, or charges waits for your Approve. Built for founders and teams, with a first focus on universities and science for hard problems. Green mode prefers smaller open-source models so you use fewer tokens. Join the waitlist for an invite.
